div.p: The scientifically critical post-cluster phase - layer discipline and boundary classification

text.tspan: assign each hit to its species + protein
exact / near / inside / outside / unknown (near <= 5 aa)

div.p: Families are not structural domains. FAMILY / homologous-superfamily entries are displayed separately and never counted as domain edges.
Sites, motifs and disorder are not domain edges by default; they are optional features. pyTMHMM is a separate topology layer, never a domain.
Raw hits are preserved for provenance. The representative domain layer drives the default scientific analysis and all boundary edges.
